backlog.title: Ambiguity check skipped when the bare-id change is unsafe or colliding
backlog.evidence: scripts/mb-work-resolve.sh Form 2 ambiguity block calls openspec_plan and treats only exit 0 as a change; when openspec/changes/<id> exists but openspec_plan exits 2 (native same-named topic, topic linked to another change, symlink) and a plan basename contains <id>, the plan resolves rc=0 silently instead of reporting the ambiguity/collision. Fix: treat exit 2 like exit 0 in the ambiguity test (or print the guard's message) and add a bats case. Edge case outside the Stage 10 DoD.

backlog.title: Move the OpenSpec target guard out of the resolver heredoc into a tested Python helper
backlog.evidence: scripts/mb-work-resolve.sh openspec_plan() embeds ~55 lines of Python in a heredoc; it is covered only through bats. A small module (e.g. in mb_openspec_paths.py) with pytest cases for path normalization, archive, symlink and linkage rules would keep the rules next to the adapter. Maintainability only; behaviour verified by probes.
